guitar.guitaristsText: John Lennon / George Harrison / Paul McCartney
guitar.modelsText: Rickenbacker 325/360-12, Gretsch, Epiphone Casino, Gibson J-160E
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: well documented across multiple guitars and eras — Lennon's Rickenbacker 325/Casino, Harrison's Gretsch/Rickenbacker 360-12, McCartney mainly bass (Hofner) with some guitar use.
guitar.notes: Original entry reasonable as a summary across three members and many guitars; kept as-is.

tone.target: bright Beatles double-track crunch with feedback bite
tone.profile: bright Beatles double-track crunch with feedback bite
tone.summary: A clean-to-crunch chain using light compression, a Vox-style preamp (UK 45), and an AC30-voiced amp/cab combination to achieve the required bright, bitey pop-rock sound.
corrections: shift from clean pop to bitey crunch

rig.name: The Beatles - I Feel Fine - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide light compression and sustain for the 'pop-rock chime' feel.
Introduce the necessary 'tight clean-to-crunch' bite without sounding heavy or dark.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is a general British crunch model, suitable for emulating Vox/AC tones.

blocks.purpose: Bypass (No dedicated distortion needed; the Green OD handles the crunch).
Simulate the small Vox/AC-style combo and provide bright upper-mid bite.
Provide a classic British voicing that complements the UK 45 amp model.
Enhance the 'bright upper-mid bite' and add chime to the overall tone.
Avoid chorus as per the 'avoid' list.
Create the 'riff feedback start' and add subtle depth to the pop-rock sound.
blocks.gap: A dedicated reverb/delay unit would be ideal for controlled feedback, but Digital Delay serves this purpose well.

blocks.purpose: Add minimal room ambience without sounding dark or overly wet.
blocks.gap: The requirement is 'minimal room', so the mix must be kept low.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to better capture the bright, chimey Rickenbacker/Vox sound.

proposals.reason: The current UK Vintage 4x12 is too large and dark for the required bright, chimey pop sound.
